instruction: A candid street photograph with a full-body shot of two women posing on a city sidewalk. On the left, the woman with long brown hair and glasses in a green coat (R1) stands smiling warmly. On the right, the woman with short dark hair in an orange sweater (R2) embraces her closely, wrapping her left arm around the tall woman's shoulder and placing her right hand gently on her chest. They stand in affectionate contact under soft natural daylight against classic city buildings.
